faqs.question: What are Dr. Bruce Vafa's qualifications and experience?
faqs.answer: Dr. Bruce Vafa has over 35 years of clinical experience and holds advanced credentials (DDS, MS). He specializes in holistic dentistry, cosmetic smile design, and TMJ treatment. Established in 1989, Dr. Vafa has earned 300+ five-star Google reviews.

faqs.question: Is holistic dentistry scientifically proven and safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Holistic dentistry uses biocompatible, mercury-free materials proven safe by extensive research. Dr. Vafa prioritizes minimally invasive techniques that support your overall health while delivering beautiful results.

faqs.question: Are porcelain veneers permanent? How long do they last?
faqs.answer: Porcelain veneers are a long-term solution, typically lasting 10-20+ years with proper care. Dr. Vafa uses premium materials and precise facial aesthetic techniques to ensure natural, durable results.

faqs.question: Can you provide before-and-after photos of real patients?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We have an extensive gallery of real patient transformations showcasing cosmetic dentistry, veneers, and smile makeovers. Visit our Before & After gallery or request examples during your consultation.
